_schema_note: Every field below is read/written by the orchestrator with Read/Write — no external task-tracker, no server. status lifecycle: pending->red->green->triangulate->refactor->done (or blocked). role/verifier/approval_criteria/rollback/handoff/blocked_reason are the minimal operable AI-company task model (SKILL.md rule: labels alone don't count) — see orchestrator-opus.md § MINIMAL AI-COMPANY TASK MODEL for the full protocol these fields plug into.

tasks.description: One atomic action — one function or module
tasks.verifier: scripts/verify-red.sh|.ps1 (mechanical, not a persona — no role certifies its own gate)
tasks.approval_criteria: <spec.md AC-id this task closes, verbatim, e.g. 'AC-2: rejects empty input'>
tasks.rollback: git revert <commit-sha, filled after this task's commit lands>
tasks.handoff: RED pass -> Builder (GREEN) -> Triangulator (TRIANGULATE, derives edge cases from approval_criteria) -> Refactor-Engineer (REFACTOR)
